statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of syncope and near-syncope
The patient has known atherosclerotic heart disease of the native coronary arteries (I25.10)
Intermittent arrhythmia is suspected as the underlying etiology of these collapse events
Mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring (CPT 93229) was billed
The denial reason code is CO-197
The denial was based on lack of required precertification or prior authorization
Mobile cardiac telemetry is medically necessary to capture continuous rhythm data during symptomatic periods
